verdict.rationale: Paychex runs a developer portal with an API library, a 'Get Started' tool kit and simple code samples. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive reference, a try-it console or runnable examples. Probes for a public OpenAPI/Swagger spec all returned 404, so there is no machine-readable spec behind an interactive explorer either. Static docs and sample code are an adjacent feature, not the interactive, runnable reference the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
